name: SS7 & Diameter Protocol Analysis
description: Ability to analyze the security of SS7 (Signaling System 7) and Diameter signaling protocols used in telecom core networks. Covers assessment of MAP/CAP/ISUP message security, Diameter AVP manipulation, location tracking via signaling, call and SMS interception vectors, subscriber data extraction, and evaluation of signaling firewalls and filtering effectiveness.

0.label: None
0.description: No exposure to SS7 or Diameter signaling security

1.label: Awareness
1.description: Understands telecom signaling architecture and known vulnerability classes
evidence: Can describe the SS7 protocol stack and the role of MAP, CAP, and ISUP
Understands Diameter signaling in LTE/EPC and 5G non-standalone, and that 5G standalone uses HTTP/2 service-based interfaces with SEPP at the roaming boundary
Completed training on telecom signaling security and known attack vectors

2.label: Guided Practice
2.description: Analyzes signaling traffic and executes basic assessment procedures under supervision
evidence: Parsed and analyzed SS7/MAP message captures using Wireshark or SigPloit under guidance
Identified location tracking, subscriber data query, and call interception message types
Executed basic SS7 assessment procedures against lab signaling infrastructure under supervision

3.label: Independent Practice
3.description: Independently assesses SS7 and Diameter signaling security
evidence: Independently assessed signaling security for 3+ telecom operators or deployments
Evaluated signaling firewall rule effectiveness against GSMA-documented attack categories
Demonstrated location tracking, subscriber profiling, and interception vectors in controlled environments
Produced GSMA-aligned assessment reports with risk-rated findings and remediation priorities

4.label: Advanced / Mentor
4.description: Performs advanced signaling attacks; assesses firewall bypass techniques; develops assessment automation
evidence: Developed signaling firewall bypass techniques exploiting filtering gaps or message crafting
Assessed cross-protocol attack chains (SS7/Diameter/GTP interworking vulnerabilities)
Built automated signaling security assessment tools for the lab
Mentors junior analysts on telecom signaling security and reviews assessment reports

5.label: Expert / Authority
5.description: Recognized authority on telecom signaling security; advises operators and regulators
evidence: Published research on SS7 or Diameter security vulnerabilities or assessment techniques
Authored the lab's telecom signaling security assessment methodology
Advises telecom operators or regulators on signaling security architecture and controls
Trains teams on signaling security and develops lab assessment infrastructure

assessment_methods.description: Execute a structured SS7/Diameter security assessment against lab telecom signaling infrastructure, demonstrating key attack categories and firewall bypass techniques
Review telecom signaling assessment reports for GSMA alignment, attack coverage completeness, and remediation quality
